name: Lokad for Aerospace
summary: Probabilistic forecasting and optimization that tells MROs and airlines what to buy, repair, stage or move, layered on SAP, AMOS, Ramco or IFS.
paragraphs: Probabilistic forecasting and optimization that tells MROs and airlines what to buy, repair, stage or move, layered on SAP, AMOS, Ramco or IFS.
whyItMatters: Works on intermittent demand and repair turnaround times, with each decision priced in dollars; Revima is a named user.
